# Recreation Prompt

Recreate a portrait-first browser pet simulator called Pika-Plush Garden Quest. Preserve the virtual pet care mechanics: a start overlay, three needs meters, feed/play/sleep buttons, pet comfort tap, meadow tap that tosses a toy, pet walking to targets, food consumption, toy contact reward, sleep recharge, and blocked feedback while sleeping. Present the loop as a cozy satirical Zelda-inspired fairy garden: a yellow plush mascot main character near a tiny shrine, carrot hero stew, fairy-yarn quests, zen shield energy, hearts and sparkles, soft anti-anxiety pacing, mobile-readable HUD, bottom thumb controls, and catalog-backed friendly fantasy fonts/audio.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Source Truth
- genre: browser-native virtual pet needs-management simulator.
- objective: keep the companion cared for by feeding, petting/comforting, playing, and resting.
- input model: one-thumb pointer/touch; start button enters play, bottom buttons trigger feed/play/sleep, canvas tap on pet comforts, canvas tap away tosses toy.
- core loop: needs slowly decay while awake; actions restore hunger/love/energy; pet walks toward food or toy; sleep restores energy and blocks other care actions.
- fail/friction state: no hard loss state; low needs are gentle pressure, and sleep mode intentionally blocks feed/play/pet with feedback.

## Protected Mechanics
- Preserve the start overlay, active care state, three-meter HUD, pet movement toward targets, feed consumption over time, toy chase completion, sleep recharge, blocked sleep feedback, audio unlock on user gesture, and canvas/mobile input semantics.

## Remix Interpretation
The same care loop is reframed as a satirical Zelda-adjacent fairy garden pet simulator: the player is caretaker of a Pika-Plush main character resting near a tiny shrine, snacks become hero stew/carrots, play becomes fairy-yarn mini quests, energy becomes a zen shield, and sleep becomes moss nap mode. The remix changes world, HUD copy, procedural background, audio mood, and focal styling without changing rules.
